verified_contracts: Complete 180 oracle slots and independent first-action replay records are required, with exact certificate, state and input-summary hash bindings.

Both references score full command plus EOS on the same exact causal prompt. Token lengths, prompt/action hashes and raw context hashes are checked. Stable T=1 softmax and one fixed SHA64/CDF draw implement the candidate without a score-conditioned pool expansion or redraw.
All three label files are generated and locked from complete selection rows before actual learner-continuation outcomes. Privileged oracle evidence, scores and Q do not enter student context.

Each eligible diagnostic command is executed after an exact replay, then the frozen learner continues from its actual successor to the original total 100-step boundary. Teacher success cannot substitute for Q.

Gate calculation requires exactly the complete expected set of actual Q branches at the fixed 36 planned anchors. Coverage, variation, q-uniform, q-expert and label-difference thresholds match candidate v2.

Only explicit structural unavailability receives null Q and zero intervention difference. Missing, duplicate, technical, replay or budget failures stop with no evaluable gate; no available-prefix calculation is admitted.

Score calls reserve padded forward and target work durably before invocation. The generation/environment ledger includes prefix, forced action and continuation work, cumulative limits and incomplete-call evidence.

The worker verifies all bound sources, runtime/data files, complete adapter directory and base inventory, physical GPU2 receipt, prior stage/cost lineage and absolute deadline. It performs no training or held-out rollout.
scope_limits: This is a component implementation review, not adoption or launch authorization. The parent controller still owns process supervision, cleanup, cumulative deadline and serialized stage requests.
Pure fixtures do not establish empirical utility. Actual diagnostic results may fail the fixed gate, in which case candidate v2 stops before training and held-out evaluation.
